title: Video pilots: SSR ultimate (Kling 3.0 / Seedance 2.5) + memorial
owner_gate: M-gate: owner approves the start frames and the pilot clips; face-similarity and size gates after encoding

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
assumptions: video prices come from R2/PS and are not re-quoted tonight
start frames are placeholders until H1/H4 finals are approved

candidates_policy: ultimate: 2 Kling prompts x 3 attempts (6 x 10 cr) + 1 Seedance prompt x 2 attempts (2 x 35 cr); memorial: 2 Kling prompts x 3 attempts (6 x 10 cr)

selection.gate: face similarity to the start frame + final .ogv size <= 0.9 MB
criteria: no redraw of the frame (the main failure of seedance_2_5 omni_reference in the earlier pilot)
no extra blink / double wink; anatomy stays 5/5
seam: first and last frame match for loops (drift check)
no text appears; style and colors identical to the key frame

pilot.go_rule: one 10 cr Kling attempt on the approved start frame before the rest

tool_note: Plan prices: Kling 3.0 10 cr per 5 s, Seedance 2.5 35 cr per 5 s (R2/PS). VIDEO_BIBLE lists different prices (kling3_0 7 cr, kling4_0 15 cr per 4 s, seedance_2_5 64 cr) and `kling4_0` as the loop winner: run estimate_video_cost before every task and re-plan if the quote exceeds max_credits.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.
